title: Prayer
description: Share your prayer requests and pray for others.
descriptionPastoral: You see every request, including those only for pastors or leaders.

empty.open: No open requests. Would you like to share yours?
empty.mine: You haven't shared any requests yet.
empty.received: No requests from the form yet. Share the QR code so anyone can ask for prayer, without an account.

deleteBodyMine: The request will no longer be visible to anyone.
deleteBodyModerate: The request will no longer be visible to anyone. The author is not notified.
answeredSaved: Praise God! It was marked as answered.

form.body: What would you like us to pray for?
form.bodyPlaceholder: Tell it in your own words.
form.publicHint: It shows on the church's prayer wall.
form.leaderHint: It goes to {{names}}. Pastors can see it too.
form.noLeader: You're not in a cell with a leader.
form.anonymousHint: Others won't see who asked; pastors will.

answer.title: Answered request
answer.intro: Wonderful! If you like, share how God answered to encourage others.
answer.testimonyPlaceholder: Visible to those who can see your request.

share.title: Prayer form
share.body: Anyone can ask for prayer by scanning this QR code, without an account. Requests arrive here, for the pastors only.

requester.title: Request from the form
requester.greeting: Hi {{name}}! I’m writing from the church about your prayer request.

wall.no: Doesn’t want it shared on the wall.
wall.anonymous: Allows sharing it on the wall, without their name.
wall.named: Allows sharing it on the wall, with their name.

replies.title: Conversation
replies.hint: Only the requester and the team looking after it can see it.
replies.hintMine: Only you and those looking after your request can see it.
replies.empty: No replies yet. Write a few words of encouragement.
replies.emptyRequester: No replies yet. When someone from the church writes to you, you’ll see it here.
replies.placeholder: Words of encouragement, a verse, when you’ll call…

publicForm.title: Ask for prayer
publicForm.subtitle: Tell us what you’d like us to pray for. At {{church}} we will pray for you.
publicForm.body: What would you like us to pray for?
publicForm.name: Your name (optional)
publicForm.nameHint: If you leave it blank, your request arrives without a name.
publicForm.wantsContact: I’d like someone to contact me
publicForm.wantsContactHint: Leave a phone or an email so we can reach you.
publicForm.contactRequired: To contact you, leave a phone or an email.
publicForm.wallShare: Can we share it with the church?
publicForm.wallShareHint: The pastors always read it first; they only share it if you allow it.
publicForm.consent: I agree that {{church}} keeps my request and my details to pray for me and reply to me. You can ask us to delete them at any time.
publicForm.thanksBody: At {{church}} we will pray for you.
publicForm.keepBody: It’s the only way back to your request: there you’ll see the church’s replies and be able to answer.
publicForm.keepBodyEmail: It’s how you get back to your request to see the replies and answer. We also emailed it to you.

link.title: Your prayer request
link.contactPending: You asked to be contacted: someone from the church will reach out soon.
link.repliesHint: Only you and those looking after your request at {{church}} can see it.
link.withdrawBody: Your request and the conversation will no longer be visible and this link will stop working.
link.withdrawnBody: It’s no longer visible to the church. If you need to, you can ask for prayer again from the form.
link.notFoundTitle: This request is no longer available
link.notFoundBody: It may have been withdrawn or the link may be incomplete.
link.privacy: Anyone with this link can see your request: don’t share it with anyone you don’t want to read it.
